scripts.text:
[Swordman]
It...
Can't be...
You've been reborn, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
这...不可能...
你转生了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
I see you're retreading the path of the Swordman! Once you've gotten used to brandishing a sword, you can never go back!!
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
看来你又踏上剑士之路了！
一旦习惯了挥剑的感觉，就再也回不去了！！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmm? Ah, you must first master the Basic Skills before you are ready to become a Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
嗯？
啊，你得先掌握基本技能，才能成为剑士。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Come back to me when you have finished learning the Basic Novice Skills.
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
等你学完初心者基本技能后再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Excellent! Let me promote you to a Swordman right away!
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
很好！
现在就为你转职成剑士！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmm... You look like a well-experienced Swordman. Still, I'm sure that you must train to improve your skills and gain strength!
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
嗯...你看起来已经是个经验丰富的剑士了。
不过，仍然要勤加训练，磨练技艺，增强实力！

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hm...?
You're a reborn
warrior, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
嗯...？
你是转生后的战士，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Swordman]
Hmmm...
It seems that being
a Swordman is not part
of your destiny. I'm sorry,
but it seems there is nothing
I can do for you.
scripts.translation:
[剑士]
嗯...
看来，剑士并非命运为你安排的道路。
抱歉，我恐怕帮不上什么忙。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
This is the Swordman Guild.
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
这里是剑士公会。
你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Tell me about being a Swordman.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于剑士的事

scripts.text: I want to be a Swordman.
scripts.translation: 我想成为剑士

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
So you wish to know more about the mighty Swordman? Okay!
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
你想多了解强大的剑士？好！

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
The most distinctive feature of the Swordman is that the Swordman can show us his/her real abilities in close combat.
There are three reasons!
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
剑士最大的特点，就是能在近战中发挥真正的实力。
原因有三！

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
First, Swordman has higher HP than other jobs.
Second, except for Bows and Rods, Swordman can use all other weapons so they can fight at their optimal ability.
And third, most of the skills of the Swordman give powerful physical attacks.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
第一，剑士的HP比其他职业更高。
第二，除了弓和法杖，剑士可以使用其他所有武器，从而发挥最佳战斗力。
第三，剑士的大部分技能都提供强大的物理攻击。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Though I gave you a simple explanation, I believe you understand the core meaning of what it is to be a Swordman.
In my opinion, Swordman is the best job ever!
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
虽然我给你的解释很简单，但我相信你已经理解了成为剑士的核心意义。
在我看来，剑士是最好的职业！

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
You are already an excellent Swordman, aren't you?
Just devote yourself to be a great Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
你已经是一名优秀的剑士了，不是吗？
专心成为一名伟大的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
You already have one of the other jobs, don't you?
You've gone too far with that joke.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
你已经有别的职业了，不是吗？
这个玩笑开得太过分了。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I'm sorry to tell you this but to be a Swordman, you must reach at least ^4A4AFFJob Level 10^000000.
and ^4A4AFFBasic Skill Level 9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
很遗憾，要成为剑士，至少要达到^4A4AFF职业等级10^000000，以及^4A4AFF基本技能等级9^000000。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Hmm, both your Job Level and Basic Skill Level check out.
Good. Do you want to be a Swordman right away?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
嗯，你的职业等级和基本技能等级都符合要求。
很好。你想立刻成为剑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Want to be a Swordman without having the minimum requirement?
Do you think being a Swordman is that easy?
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
没有达到最低要求就想成为剑士？
你以为成为剑士那么容易吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有

scripts.text: I'll consider it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Yeah. Prudent decision is needed for choosing a job.
But I feel sorry... that you consider it again after overcoming all the hardships....
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
没错，选择职业需要谨慎。
不过真遗憾...你都克服了所有困难，却又要重新考虑...

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Congratulations! From now on, you are going to live a Swordman's life!
Let's do it right now!
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
恭喜！从现在起，你将过上剑士的生活！
马上开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Congratulations again for being a Swordman and I hope that you participate in many activities for the revival of our guild.
scripts.translation:
[剑士公会成员]
再次恭喜你成为剑士，希望你能积极参加我们公会的各种复兴活动。
